newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold, silver end down on selling, low demand.
newsitem.headline: India gold, silver end down on selling, low demand.

text.p: Gold and silver opened steady but dropped towards close on Monday on sluggish demand and stray selling by importers and traders, dealers said.
"Selling continued today amid reports of a downtrend in the world market," said a dealer.
Fresh arrivals of imported gold and silver and lower than expected seasonal buying pushed prices down, dealers said.
Silver was up 45 rupees per kg while gold was down 30 rupees per 10 grammes last week.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) settled 100 rupees lower at 58,500 rupees per piece. They were down 300 rupees last week.
